text:
incident-bot: Pager: PROD - increased crashloop/5xx rate on hosted inference (severity=sev2). Notifying oncall nora diaz.

nora diaz: I'm on it. Saw multiple crashloops in cluster pool-omega, nodes gnode-07/gnode-08. Containers exit with SIGSEGV in trt_integration.so.

samir reddy: Metrics: /v1/chat errors up to 25%, p99 latency spikes to 4s then 502s. A few high-volume customers reporting failures.

alice ng: Pulling logs now. Got CUDA backtrace: ```FATAL: segfault at pc=0x7f8c9b2f in kernel_trt_ops.cu: apply_attention+0x2c
libtrt_integration.so!invoke_kernel()+0x10b
GPU err: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (4)
``` Looks tied to TensorRT fused attention path.

paul morrison: Repro on staging with same image `redwood/runtime:2026-07-19-trt`. Small synthetic load causes immediate segfault. If I set env `ENABLE_TRT_FUSION=false` process survives (higher CPU, slower).

nora diaz: Emergency mitigation: divert production traffic away from pool-omega. `rdwctl route update hosted --remove-pool pool-omega --add-pool pool-alpha --weight 100` Applying now.

deploy-bot: Detected recent deployment of image redwood/runtime:2026-07-19-trt to pool-omega ~90m ago. Auto-suggest: rollback to redwood/runtime:2026-06-29-stable.

samir reddy: I've increased pod restart backoff for pool-omega to 300s to limit churn: `kubectl patch deployment runtime-pool-omega -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"terminationGracePeriodSeconds":30}}}}'` and `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-pool-omega POD_RESTART_BACKOFF=300s`

alice ng: Rolling hotconfig to disable TRT fusion on pool-omega: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-pool-omega ENABLE_TRT_FUSION=false` Rolling restart started.

nora diaz: After disabling fusion, 80% of pods stabilized; error rate down to ~4% in 10 minutes. Two pods still crash on startup.

paul morrison: For the two straggler pods I attached gdb; segfault happens during static init of trt kernels before env read. Captured core dumps, uploading to s3: s3://redwood-incident-cores/3333456789-cores.tar.gz

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress.

samir reddy: Plan: quick rollback of runtime image for pool-omega to `redwood/runtime:2026-06-29-stable`. Will schedule image change in 3m unless objections.

alice ng: Alternative short term: apply per-deployment patch to force CPU fallback for enterprise routes while we rollback. `rdwctl route update --route acct-42 --set-override fallback=cpu`

nora diaz: Executed image rollback. Watching pod rollout. Stable image coming up cleanly. Crashloops stopped on all nodes.

paul morrison: Root cause hypothesis: regression in TRT fused attention change interacting with specific NVIDIA driver versions (470.x family) leading to illegal PTX generation on some GPUs. Core shows unexpected instruction bytes.

samir reddy: Repro instructions saved: quantized model Y, seq=1024, batch=1, runtime image 2026-07-19-trt triggers segfault on driver 470.128. Filed bug RUNTIME-3301 with repro link and cores.

deploy-bot: Temporarily blocked tag 2026-07-19-trt from rollout.

nora diaz: Customer impact note: incident start ~2026-07-23T02:44Z, mitigation (traffic diversion + disable fusion + rollback) restored service by 02:58Z. Estimated customer-minutes affected ~900 across 12 customers; 2 enterprise customers escalated. Support notified.

alice ng: Ops follow-ups: collect full driver matrix for affected nodes, add a deploy-time driver compatibility check, add early runtime guard to fail fast to CPU fallback when fused kernel fails init.

nora diaz: Handoff to night oncall kevin. Summary: segfaults due to TRT fused attention regression in image 2026-07-19-trt; mitigations done (traffic routed away, fusion disabled, image rolled back). Cores + logs uploaded, bug RUNTIME-3301 created.

kevin (oncall): Ack. I'll leave pool-omega drained and monitor. Will coordinate with eng-runtime tomorrow for patch/rollback verification.

incident-bot: Incident closed (manual) by nora diaz. Severity downgraded to sev3 for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
